verdict.rationale: Figma's REST API authentication docs describe plan access tokens. They are scoped to an organization or enterprise plan, are not tied to a personal account, and are meant for CI/CD, logging and user-agnostic tasks, which suits issuing a non-personal credential to an agent. However, the pack shows only plan-level scoping, not fine-grained least-privilege permission scopes. Missing for 10: documented per-permission scopes (e.g. read-only or per-resource), agent-specific credential guidance, token expiry/revocation controls, independent corroboration.
